strings.name: Ariana Grande
strings.summary: Grande moved from musical theater and teen television into international pop, combining vocal agility, R&B and personal storytelling. Sweetener earned a Grammy; she organized benefit music after the Manchester attack. Playing Glinda in Wicked expanded her film career. She released petal in 2026, continuing across records, stage and screen.
